Jenna Ortega, Sadie Sink, Sabrina Carpenter, Sydney Sweeney

Created via @yapper_so 

Prompt :-
Use the provided reference image for the subject’s identity, facial features, body proportions, hair, and overall likeness. Preserve the exact face, skin tone, and realism from the reference image without alteration.
The subject is wearing a matching two-piece activewear set in dusty blush pink / matte pastel pink. The outfit consists of a minimalist thin-strap sports bra with a scoop neckline and high-waisted, form-fitting leggings. Nails are medium-length, almond-shaped, painted in a pale pink or nude polish.
The subject is posing for a mirror selfie, standing upright. The left hand rests on the hip, while the right hand holds a silver or white smartphone at face level.
The environment is a bright, modern Pilates studio. A wooden Pilates reformer machine with black tension springs and cables is visible. The background includes a pink padded reformer carriage and neatly stacked pink foam yoga blocks. The walls are clean and neutral, in off-white or light grey tones.
Lighting is soft, diffused indoor studio lighting, creating even illumination with natural reflections and minimal harsh shadows.
Medium shot to full-body mirror selfie composition, subject centered vertically. Portrait orientation with a 3:4 aspect ratio. High-resolution, photorealistic fitness lifestyle aesthetic, with sharp focus on the subject and a shallow depth of field that softly blurs the background.

items.prompt:
想做短视频副业，但不想每晚熬夜剪片

与其开会员堆一堆软件，不如直接试试这四个能串起工作流的Github项目

从生成、剪辑、翻译到多平台发布

1、视频生成：MoneyPrinterTurbo
输入一个主题，就能先把文案、配音、字幕和素材初稿跑出来，适合快速搭建一条视频框架。
：https://github.com/harry0703/MoneyPrinterTurbo…

2、视频剪辑：FunClip
先识别视频内容，再按文本片段剪视频，能大幅缩减视频剪辑时间。
：https://github.com/modelscope/FunClip…

3、视频翻译：KrillinAl
做视频翻译、配音、多语言适配，适合把一条内容扩成多语种版本（Tiktok、ins等）。
：https://github.com/krillinai/KrillinAI…

4、多平台发布：social-auto-upload
前面都做完了，最后一公里别再手动重复发。这个项目可以实现抖音、小红书、B站多平台分发。
 ：https://github.com/dreammis/social-auto-upload…

如果想了解更多的赚钱项目，请看我收录的Github赚钱项目列表。
